question.prompt: A person commutes \(x\) km each day. A private car emits 0.2 kg per kilometer, while a bus emits 0.05 kg per kilometer. To save at least 3 kg of emissions per day by switching to the bus, what is the minimum value of \(x\), in km?

solutions.explanation: Write the inequality \((0.2-0.05)x\geq3\), or \(0.15x\geq3\), giving \(x\geq20\). Thus, \(x\) must be at least 20 km.
solutions.title: Model the minimum saving
